RustyShelf 0.6.0 opens Trophies game by game, puts Details in order and can update itself.

## New

- **Trophies game by game.** T on the shelf opens Trophies with RetroAchievements, RPCS3's PS3 trophies and Steam, all together or one at a time (From ◀ ▶). A game opens its achievements, each with its own picture on the left and how rare it is and its points (a trophy's grade for RPCS3) on the right; an achievement opens on its own page with **How to get it**, a YouTube search for it in your browser. Details' achievements are listed the same way.
- **Details in order.** **Read the manual** sits beside Play (← →), the rows below are in sections (Your game; Achievements, manual & screenshots; Box art; About), and the description keeps its place as you move.
- **A Manual tile** in the quick menu (Esc) for a game with a manual.
- **A Favorites shelf**, in Settings → Look beside All games. The first run asks for both.
- **The emulator's case** ("Open PCSX2") wears the emulator's own icon on Windows. Settings → each console → Emulator's case puts a picture of yours on it instead.
- **Ports and recomps** get the back of the box of the console game they're made from (with Backs of the box from LaunchBox on).
- **Drawn backs** show a game's first four screenshots when it has them.
- **Update by itself** (Settings → System, off by default): a newer release is downloaded, checked against its SHA-256 sum and used from the next start. Check for a new version installs one on a second press.
- **The tour** opens the real screens and points at each part.
- **Surprise me** has its switch in Settings again.
- **KytyPS5** is the PS5's emulator, and is found on Linux too.

## Fixed

- The quick menu and the Sort panel no longer blink as you move in them.
- LaunchBox's PC games say when they're being saved after the download, go on with Settings shut, and no longer cover other rows' hints with their progress.
- Achievement pictures are kept in `data/ach-icons`, so lists don't ask for them again.
- A folder in the PC games folder that holds several games gives a game for each.
- On Linux, Epic installs stopped half way no longer show up as PC games.
- A LaunchBox art download, or a setup being brought over, that stops now says so instead of hanging.
- A Settings page no longer opens with its cursor on a section's heading.
- Lots of duplicated code behind the scenes was folded into shared helpers.

## Download

| | File | |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `RustyShelf-0.6.0-windows-setup.exe` | The installer. |
| | `RustyShelf-0.6.0-windows.zip` | The app and its `data` folder, to unzip anywhere. `--windowed` starts it in a window. |
| **Linux** | `RustyShelf-0.6.0-linux.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it once, then start it. |
| **Android** | `RustyShelf-0.6.0-android.apk` | arm64. Installs over 0.5.x. |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has each file's SHA-256 sum.

The manual lists [everything that works](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/docs/MANUAL.md#what-works). Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues).
